**I did not run the suite locally** — `make` and bare `uv run pytest` are outside this profile, as the task states. **And I observed no CI result either, because I opened no PR.** So this change has no verification behind it at all right now. That is the honest state.

## Other launcher/profile friction worth a ticket

- **`Bash` shapes.** `grep -n <pat> <file>` and `ls && cat x` were allowed, but a `for f in …; do cat "$f"; done` loop and a `grep …; echo …; grep …` compound were both denied. The profile lists no `grep`/`cat`/`ls` rules at all, so those must be passing through a read-only-command heuristic that loops and `;`-separated compounds fall out of. A lane should keep Bash to single simple commands; batching reads into a loop costs a denial and a round trip.
- **`Write` is not in the allow list** yet succeeded on `.agents/…` — so `Edit(**)` appears to cover it. That is fine, but it means the profile's allow list is not a complete description of what a lane can do, in either direction.
- **The `.claude/` block is the structural one.** Half of every runtime-parity task in this repo lives in `.claude/commands/`, `.claude/rules/`, or `.claude/agents/`. A headless Claude lane that cannot write there cannot complete a parity change on its own — this task is the proof. Worth a tracker item independent of how you unblock me here.
